content.text: **Summary:** I read ticket T-3002, inspected the `vision` namespace, and found `doc-embedder-6f9b8d7c5-r4tkq` stuck in `Pending`. The scheduler condition message revealed the GPU nodes carry the taint `dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule`, which the pod's toleration list does not cover — despite having the `nvidia.com/gpu:NoSchedule` toleration. I resolved the ticket with instructions to add a `dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule` toleration to the Deployment spec, which will allow the scheduler to place the pod on the GPU nodes.
